name: Avocado ice cream
summary: Blended avocado dessert sold around Da Lat’s market slope, eaten cold from a cup.
origin: Da Lat snack counters; the town’s cool climate and local avocados made this a visitor staple.
howToEat: Eat it standing at the counter while it is still cold.
It is a sweet snack, not a meal. Pair it with strawberries if you are walking the market.
seoTitle: Avocado ice cream — Da Lat kem bo
seoDescription: Blended avocado dessert around Da Lat market and night stalls. Stall prices are check on arrival.
